scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check sw.js && node --check scripts/update-fixtures.mjs && node --check scripts/worldcup-bracket.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-mobile.mjs && node scripts/validate-form-data.mjs
scripts.mobile:build: npm run build && npm run mobile:prepare
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add ios
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
